SHW.rationale: Sherwin-Williams is a high-quality franchise with dominant market position (69%+ US paint store revenue share), strong brand portfolio, and a vertically integrated distribution moat of 5,000+ company-owned stores. Q1 2026 showed solid YoY growth (+6.8% revenue, +7.5% EPS) with record EBITDA of $998M and gross margin expansion. However, several factors temper enthusiasm: (1) QoQ trajectory is weak with revenue -10.9% and EPS -35.8% from Q3 2025, reflecting seasonal softness and persistent demand headwinds; (2) operating cash flow collapsed to $139M in Q1 vs $1.31B in Q3, though this is partly seasonal; (3) management guided flat for the year citing elevated mortgage rates and weak DIY demand, with volume guidance moderated toward potential low-single-digit declines; (4) raw material inflation outlook was raised to low-to-mid single digits with Middle East geopolitical risks adding uncertainty.
